policy.decade_2020: 2020 is a SINGLE-YEAR edge case. It is NOT a full decade (2020s). When 2020 data is present, display label as '2020' or '2020 (single year)' — NOT '2020s'. Caption must note that 2020 represents only the year 2020, not a 10-year aggregate.
policy.aggregation: mean by decade using pandas groupby; skipna=True
policy.pre_computed_decade_in_source: yes — dataset contains 'decade' column computed as (release_year // 10) * 10

note: The dataset has a pre-computed 'decade' column. Dashboard may use this directly for decade-level aggregation instead of re-deriving.
